about.title: About NEO SSH-Win Manager
about.desc:
A modern GUI frontend for sshfs-win.
Mount remote SSH filesystems as Windows drive letters.
about.what_it_does.title: Features
about.what_it_does.body: Mount remote SSH filesystems as Windows drive letters with one click. Multi-user support with encrypted credential storage. Built-in SSH terminal, system info panel, live tray toggles, and optional CLI companion for automation. Built on WinFsp + SSHFS-Win.

ftp.mount_unsupported.title: Not available for {proto}
ftp.mount_unsupported: '{name}' is an {proto} connection. Mounting as a drive letter needs SSHFS and is only available for SFTP. Use the file browser instead.
ftp.ssh_unsupported: '{name}' is an {proto} connection – there is no SSH terminal for it.
ftp.explorer_tls_unsupported: Windows Explorer only supports plain FTP without TLS. Use the built-in browser for FTPS.
addedit.ftp.implicit.hint: Off = explicit TLS (AUTH TLS) on port 21 – the usual setting.
addedit.ftp.passive.hint: Passive mode works behind most firewalls and routers. Only turn it off if the server requires active mode.
addedit.ftp.verify_cert.hint: Turn off only for self-signed certificates. The connection stays encrypted, but the server identity is no longer verified.
addedit.ftp.hint: FTP connections cannot be mounted as a drive letter and have no SSH terminal – use the file browser.
addedit.ftp.plain_warning: Plain FTP transmits password and data unencrypted. Use FTPS whenever the server offers it.
